description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapCanvas' for rendering an interactive mind map visualization, including node and edge rendering, zooming, panning, and label wrapping. It also includes related type definitions for nodes, edges, viewport, and component props.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a given text into multiple lines based on max characters per line and max lines, adding ellipses if text exceeds limits.

methods.name: computeRadialLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions for nodes in a radial layout, centering the 'current' or 'current role' node and arranging recommended nodes around it.
